newsitem.title: USA: Cargill Inc says not involved in price-fixing.
newsitem.headline: Cargill Inc says not involved in price-fixing.

text.p: Cargill Inc said it is confident federal investigations of the citric acid and high fructose corn syrup industries will show it has not engaged in price fixing, adding that it is not a target of the probes.

"As we have said from the beginning of these investigations, Cargill has conducted itself properly, competing openly to grow our businesses in the citric acid and high fructose corn syrup industries," Cargill said in a statement. "We are confident the pending federal inquiries into these businesses will confirm that conclusion."
